明确退出会停止受管服务。进程意外中断时保留诊断记录，不接管其他应用。: Quitting stops managed services. Unexpected exits leave diagnostic records; Flint does not take over other applications.

停止由 Flint 处理，无需提供 stop command。: Flint handles stopping; no stop command is required.
首次部署会下载依赖和模型。进程、模型准备与 API 状态分别检查。: First-time setup downloads dependencies and models. Process, model readiness, and API status are checked separately.
命令中的 ${port} 会替换为上方端口；仅填写端口不会改变程序本身的行为。: ${port} in the command is replaced by the configured port. Changing the port alone does not change how your program starts.
服务会先自动停止，再从列表中删除。选择是否同时清理以下内容；不勾选则仅删除登记。: The service will stop and be removed from the list. Choose any files to delete as well; leave all unchecked to keep the files.
删除服务数据、日志和专用缓存: Delete service data, logs, and dedicated cache
其他服务仍共用此版本，环境与模型会保留。: Other services share this version. Its environment and models will be kept.

共享 Python 和下载缓存保留，其他版本不受影响。: Shared Python and download caches are kept. Other versions are unaffected.
外部项目目录和环境保留。: The external project directory and environment are kept.
勾选的文件会直接删除，重新使用时可能需要下载。: Selected files are deleted directly and may need to be downloaded again.
· 在应用市场选择其他版本，已有环境将保留。: · Choose another release in the app catalog; the existing environment will be kept.
改变解析配置后需重新准备对应模型。独立环境与已有下载会被复用。: Changing the parsing mode requires preparing its models. Existing environments and downloads will be reused.
保存不会执行命令。之后点击「安装项目依赖」，将按顺序在工作目录执行：: Saving does not run commands. Click “Install project dependencies” afterward to run these steps in order in the working directory:
参数按原样传递，不解释 shell 语法。修改命令或安装步骤请编辑清单后重新导入: Arguments are passed literally, without shell interpretation. Edit and reimport the manifest to change commands or installation steps; each import creates a new instance.
使用前台常驻命令。支持: Use a persistent foreground command. Supports
占位符；现有服务的依赖需已准备好。: placeholders; dependencies must already be available.

立即应用到主窗口和菜单栏，下次启动时保留。: Applies immediately to the main window and menu bar, and is saved for next time.
所选内容约 {size}。实际释放空间可能因共享文件与磁盘快照而减少。: Selected files: approximately {size}. Shared files and disk snapshots may reduce the space actually freed.
使用前台常驻命令。支持 ${port} 占位符；现有服务的依赖需已准备好。: Use a persistent foreground command. Supports the ${port} placeholder; dependencies must already be available.
将 PDF、扫描文档和图片解析为 Markdown 与结构化内容。独立环境，本地: Parse PDFs, scanned documents, and images into Markdown and structured content. Isolated environment, local HTTP API.
使用新的 /v1/tasks 协议，需要客户端支持 MinerU 4.1。: Uses the new /v1/tasks protocol; the client must support MinerU 4.1.
服务尚未通过检查: The service has not passed its readiness check
清单不得超过 64 KB: The manifest must not exceed 64 KB
不支持的 schemaVersion；请使用字符串 0.1 或 0.2: Unsupported schemaVersion; use the string 0.1 or 0.2
本版导入仅支持 schemaVersion 0.1、category servi: Version 0.1 requires category service and environment.mode existing. Managed installation uses the built-in MinerU recipe.
工作目录不存在：{error}: The working directory does not exist: {error}
0.2 仅支持 environment.mode: existing；通用 ma: Version 0.2 only supports environment.mode: existing; generic managed environments are not implemented
应用 id 需以小写字母开头，只含小写字母、数字、点、横线或下划线，最多 120: App id must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, or underscores (up to 120 characters)
version 需是非空字符串，最多 80 字符: version must be a nonempty string of up to 80 characters
platforms 仅接受 macos、linux、windows: platforms accepts only macos, linux, or windows
此清单未声明支持当前平台: This manifest does not declare support for the current platform
MCP 服务需要显式声明 healthPath，例如 /mcp: MCP services must explicitly declare healthPath, such as /mcp
清单目录不存在: The manifest directory does not exist
自定义服务的项目与环境不由 Flint 安装，不能卸载: Flint does not own this custom project's directory or environment and cannot uninstall them
其他服务仍共用此版本，不能卸载其环境或模型: Other services share this version; its environment and models cannot be uninstalled
请先确认旧进程已结束并清除中断记录: Confirm the old process has ended, then clear the interruption record

删除未完成：{error}。服务登记已保留，可重试。: Removal did not finish: {error}. The service remains registered; you can retry.
删除路径不属于 Flint 数据目录: The removal path is outside Flint's data directory
删除路径的父目录是符号链接，请先检查存储位置: A parent of the removal path is a symbolic link; check the storage location first
端口 {port} 已被占用{detail}。请先停止占用进程，或修改此服务的端: Port {port} is already in use{detail}. Stop the process using it, or change this service's port before starting.
服务意外退出（{exit}）。请查看运行日志中的具体错误。: The service exited unexpectedly ({exit}). See runtime logs for details.
program 必须是可执行文件名称或路径，不接受占位符: program must be an executable name or path; placeholders are not accepted
安装步骤不能超过 32 项: There can be at most 32 installation steps
env 名称无效，且不能覆盖 LAUNCHER_ 保留变量: Invalid environment variable name; reserved LAUNCHER_ variables cannot be overridden
命令参数不能包含 NUL: Command arguments must not contain NUL
占位符缺少结束括号: A placeholder is missing its closing brace
该 Release 尚无经过适配的安装配方: There is no adapted installation recipe for this release
请填写服务名称（最多 120 字符）: Enter a service name (up to 120 characters)
端口需要在 1024–65535 之间: The port must be between 1024 and 65535
健康检查路径需要是 / 开头的本地路径: The health check must use a local path starting with /
不能同时设置结构化 run 与 shell command: Structured run and shell command cannot both be set
请填写启动命令并选择存在的工作目录: Enter a startup command and choose an existing working directory
服务配置损坏，未覆盖原文件：{error}: Service configuration is invalid; the original file was not overwritten: {error}
上次 Launcher 未正常退出。请查看日志并确认旧进程已结束，再点击清除中断: Flint did not exit cleanly last time. Check the logs and confirm the old process has ended before clearing the record. Processes are not terminated automatically using old PIDs.
请先停止服务，再修改配置: Stop the service before changing its configuration
请在应用市场选择另一个 Release；已有实例的版本不可覆盖: Choose another release in the app catalog; an existing instance's version cannot be overwritten

尚无日志。安装或启动后，输出会显示在这里。: No logs yet. Output will appear here after installation or startup.
任务取消或达到两小时超时限制: The task was cancelled or exceeded the two-hour timeout
此服务没有声明安装步骤: This service has no installation steps

Release 缺少 Python 版本: The release is missing its Python version
缺少该 Release 的依赖锁: The dependency lock for this release is missing

下载解析模型（首次需要较长时间）: Downloading parsing models (the first download may take a while)
部署完成。点击启动以运行本地服务。: Installation complete. Start the service to run it locally.
请先完成模型准备；可点击继续部署: Prepare the models first; click Continue installation
